newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen 91-day treasury bills average 19.88 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yemen 91-day treasury bills average 19.88 pct.

text.p: The Central Bank of Yemen said on Wednesday its latest issue of 91-day treasury bills yielded an average 19.88 percent, down from an average 21.02 percent in its February 3 auction.
Of the 1.5 billion rials worth on offer, the issue attracted subscriptions worth 1.45 billion rials.
The average price was 9,527.75 rials and the lowest price accepted was 9,500 rials. Yields ranged from 18.24 percent to 21.11 percent.
The latest issue of 182-day bills yielded an average 21.46 percent, down on last month's average of 21.87.
Of the 600 million rials worth of bills on offer, the issue attracted subscriptions worth 582 million rials.
The average price was 9,035.47 rials and the lowest price accepted was 8,995 rials. Yields ranged from 20.08 percent to 22.41 percent.
The issue of 364-day bils, the third by the bank, yielded an average 22.15 percent, down on last month's 22.30 percent.
Of the 400 million rials worth of bills on offer, the issue attracted subscriptions worth 388 million rials.
The average price was 8,190.78 rials, with the lowest price accepted 8155 rials.
Yields ranged from 20.83 percent to 22.69 percent.
The bank did not say when the next issue will be held in April.
